summary: CBSSports.com's Week 11 2023 NFL injury roundup covers star players who left games, organized by position (QB, RB, WR, EDGE, DB). It gives each player's injury, whether he returned, and follow-up updates from coaches or NFL Media. Notable outcomes include Talanoa Hufanga's season-ending ACL tear, Cooper Kupp's low ankle sprain, and Kenneth Walker III's oblique strain.
one_line: A Week 11 2023 NFL injury roundup detailing injuries to Cooper Kupp, Kenneth Walker III, Talanoa Hufanga, Aaron Jones and others.
key_facts: Texans QB C.J. Stroud left for one play against the Cardinals after a hard hit, with Davis Mills entering, then returned with no injury designation.

Seahawks QB Geno Smith hurt his throwing arm after a hit from Aaron Donald with Seattle up 16-7 on the Rams; Drew Lock took over with 18 seconds left in the third quarter, and Smith returned for the final drive.
Pete Carroll said Geno Smith will 'make it back' and, asked about Thursday's game against San Francisco, said 'I would think so.'
Commanders QB Sam Howell took several hard hits on a touchdown run against the Giants, was cleared of a potential concussion, and stayed in the game.
Packers RB Aaron Jones had five carries against the Chargers before a knee injury; he was carted to the locker room, replaced by A.J. Dillon, and Matt LaFleur doesn't expect a long-term issue.
Dolphins RB De'Von Achane returned from injured reserve after a four-game absence but left with a knee injury after his second touch against the Raiders; Mike McDaniel called him day-to-day.

Seahawks RB Kenneth Walker III left after four carries against the Rams with an oblique injury; Pete Carroll called it an 'oblique strain that was legit' and said he could miss time, with rookie Zach Charbonnet replacing him.
Bears RB D'Onta Foreman managed 14 rushing yards against the Lions before an ankle injury; he did not return, even with Khalil Herbert back from injured reserve.
Dolphins WR Tyreek Hill briefly left with a hand injury but returned, finishing with seven catches for 80 yards and a score before halftime; he has returned from every game he has left this year.
Rams WR Cooper Kupp had one catch against the Seahawks before an ankle injury while blocking; NFL Media reported a low ankle sprain.
Giants WR Darius Slayton caught a deep touchdown from Tommy DeVito before leaving with an arm injury and being ruled out halfway through the third quarter.
Chargers EDGE Joey Bosa appeared to injure his right leg or foot in the first quarter against the Packers and was carted to the locker room.
49ers DB Talanoa Hufanga left early against the Buccaneers with a knee injury; Kyle Shanahan confirmed a season-ending ACL tear.
